zoxide and fzf Integration

Learn how to combine zoxide with fzf to achieve more powerful directory search and selection.

zoxide and fzf Integration

Combine zoxide with fzf for powerful fuzzy selection of directories.

What is fzf-

  • Fuzzy search for files and directories
  • Interactive selection with preview
  • Highly customizable

    • Installing fzf

    macOS

    brew install fzf

    Linux

    # Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt install fzf

# Arch Linux
sudo pacman -S fzf

    Manual install

    git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/junegunn/fzf.git ~/.fzf
~/.fzf/install

    Basic Integration

    Use fzf to pick a zoxide result

    # zsh/bash
zi() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf) && z "$dir"
}

    fish version

    function zi
 set dir (zoxide query -l | fzf)
 if test -n "$dir"
 z "$dir"
 end
end

    Advanced Integration

    Add preview

    zi() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf --preview 'ls -la {}') && z "$dir"
}

    Multi-select

    zi() {
 local dirs
 dirs=$(zoxide query -l | fzf -m)
 if [ -n "$dirs" ]; then
 echo "$dirs" | while read dir; do
 echo "Selected: $dir"
 done
 fi
}

    Practical functions

    Jump with preview

    zfp() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf --preview 'tree -L 2 {}')
 [ -n "$dir" ] && z "$dir" && ls -la
}

    Search and open editor

    zcode() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf)
 [ -n "$dir" ] && z "$dir" && code .
}

    Search then run a command

    zexec() {
 local dir cmd
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf)
 if [ -n "$dir" ]; then
 z "$dir"
 read -p "Enter command: " cmd
 eval "$cmd"
 fi
}

    fzf Configuration

    Custom theme

    export FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS='
 --color=fg:#f8f8f2,bg:#282a36,hl:#bd93f9
 --color=fg+:#f8f8f2,bg+:#44475a,hl+:#bd93f9
 --color=info:#ffb86c,prompt:#50fa7b,pointer:#ff79c6
 --color=marker:#ff79c6,spinner:#ffb86c,header:#6272a4
'

    Custom preview command

    export FZF_DEFAULT_OPTS="--preview 'tree -C {} | head -20'"

    Real-World Use

    Quick project switching

    zp() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | grep -i project | fzf)
 [ -n "$dir" ] && z "$dir"
}

    Recent directories

    zr() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | sort -k2 -rn | fzf)
 [ -n "$dir" ] && z "$dir"
}

    Filter by type (git repos)

    zgit() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | xargs -I {} sh -c 'test -d {}/.git && echo {}' | fzf)
 [ -n "$dir" ] && z "$dir"
}

    Performance Tips

  • Limit results: head -50
  • Use lighter previews when data is large
    • zi() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | head -50 | fzf)
 [ -n "$dir" ] && z "$dir"
}
    zi() {
 local dir
 dir=$(zoxide query -l | fzf --bind 'change:reload:zoxide query -l {q}') && z "$dir"
}

    Troubleshooting

    If you see fzf: command not found:

  • Verify installation
  • Ensure fzf is in PATH
  • Reload your shell config

    • Best Practices

  • Use previews when helpful, not always
  • Limit result count for large datasets
  • Make aliases for your common workflows
